newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India awards Suez Blend in June tender - traders.
newsitem.headline: India awards Suez Blend in June tender - traders.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) also awarded a very large crude carrier (VLCC) of Suez Blend crude oil in its June buying crude tender, traders said on Monday.

As reported on Friday, IOC awarded one Dubai cargo to British Petroleum Co Plc at first half quotes flat per barrel, and two Dubai cargoes to US trader Phibro at first half quotes flat and minus two cents.
It also awarded two VLCCs of Nigerian Qua Iboe crude oil to Mobil Corp.

But traders said on Monday the IOC had also awarded a VLCC of Suez Blend to Swiss trader Glencore at the official selling price +22 cents per barrel. Glencore was not immediately available to comment.
The regular monthly tender closed on Thursday and offers were made valid until Friday.
